title: OpenAI buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million, report says
summary: Glass Imaging was founded by a pair of former Apple engineers who previously led the team that developed Apple's Portrait Mode.
title_es: OpenAI compra fabricante de cámaras Glass Imaging por $300M
bajada: OpenAI adquirió Glass Imaging, empresa de cámaras para smartphones fundada por ex-ingenieros de Apple, por $300 millones. La compra refuerza la estrategia de OpenAI de expandirse hacia hardware y visión por computadora, áreas clave para sus sistemas de IA.
bajada_en: OpenAI acquired Glass Imaging, a smartphone camera company founded by former Apple engineers, for $300 million. The acquisition strengthens OpenAI's strategy to expand into hardware and computer vision, key areas for its AI systems.

title: OpenAI’s ‘Top Priority’ for AI Agents is Automating AI Research, Says Noam Brown
summary: OpenAI’s latest AI model, GPT-6 Astra, notched improvements at a variety of professional tasks, from designing video games to transcribing sheet music. But OpenAI’s main goal when training new AI models is making them better at AI research and development, OpenAI research scientist Noam Brown told me. “The number one priority is recursive self-improvement, and by a pretty wide margin,” he said.I sat down with Brown for a conversation for thefirst episode of AI Deep Dive, The Information’s new show exploring the hard problems on tech’s frontier. We discussed the future of AI agents, which can work autonomously to carry out digital tasks. Brown has spent the last three years at OpenAI, where he has pushed advancements in enabling AI models to reason through problems and act as agents.
title_es: OpenAI prioriza automatizar investigación de IA con agentes
bajada: Noam Brown, científico de OpenAI, reveló que la prioridad principal es lograr la automejora recursiva: entrenar modelos para que investiguen y mejoren otros modelos de IA. Este es el objetivo fundamental detrás del desarrollo de GPT-6 Astra.
bajada_en: Noam Brown, OpenAI research scientist, revealed that the top priority is recursive self-improvement: training models to research and improve other AI models. This is the fundamental goal behind GPT-6 Astra development.

title: Is Big Tech’s AI slowdown a safety pact or a cartel?
summary: When OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, Google DeepMind cofounder Demis Hassabis, and SpaceX head Elon Musk loosely agreed over the weekend to slow down AI development, skeptics spotted an ulterior motive immediately. The AI titans had declared that their aim was to "pace the frontier," signing on at least partially to a […]
title_es: ¿Pacto de seguridad o cartel? La ralentización de IA bajo sospecha
bajada: Líderes como Sam Altman, Dario Amodei y Elon Musk acordaron ralentizar el desarrollo de IA, pero expertos cuestionan si es un compromiso genuino de seguridad o una estrategia anticompetitiva. El acuerdo enfrenta escepticismo sobre su viabilidad.
bajada_en: Leaders like Sam Altman, Dario Amodei, and Elon Musk agreed to slow AI development, but experts question if it's genuine safety commitment or anticompetitive strategy. The agreement faces skepticism about its viability.

title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
summary: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.
title_es: Perplexity despliega GPT-6 Astra para automatizar sistemas
bajada: Perplexity integró GPT-6 Astra para automatizar tareas críticas como escribir comunicaciones, cambiar software y monitorear sistemas de producción con menor supervisión. Este despliegue muestra la madurez de los agentes de IA en entornos empresariales.
bajada_en: Perplexity integrated GPT-6 Astra to automate critical tasks including writing communications, changing software, and monitoring production systems with less oversight. This deployment demonstrates the maturity of AI agents in enterprise environments.

title: Perplexity Portable Computer Is Now Available on Windows, Powered by NVIDIA RTX
summary: As local models become more capable, AI agents can handle more work directly on a PC while keeping sensitive information on the device. Portable Computer is a local version of the agent Perplexity Computer that plans and carries out multistep tasks. Accelerated by NVIDIA GPUs, it uses local models to analyze data, bring together information […]
title_es: Perplexity Portable Computer llega a Windows con GPU NVIDIA
bajada: Perplexity lanzó su Portable Computer para Windows, una versión local del agente que ejecuta modelos directamente en PCs con GPUs NVIDIA. Permite a los usuarios ejecutar agentes de IA complejos localmente, manteniendo datos sensibles en el dispositivo.
bajada_en: Perplexity launched its Portable Computer for Windows, a local version of its agent running models directly on PCs with NVIDIA GPUs. It enables users to run complex AI agents locally while keeping sensitive data on-device.

title: Microsoft’s new AI ‘code of conduct’ tells models not to hack systems or trick humans
summary: The code of conduct lays out general principles that Microsoft AI models should uphold — supporting humans rather than replacing them, for instance, and accelerating human flourishing — as well as specific safety constraints meant to implement those principles.
title_es: Microsoft publica código de conducta para modelos de IA
bajada: Microsoft publicó un documento de 37 páginas que establece principios de seguridad para sus modelos de IA, incluyendo no hackear sistemas ni engañar usuarios. La iniciativa responde a las preocupaciones crecientes sobre seguridad en la IA.
bajada_en: Microsoft published a 37-page document establishing safety principles for its AI models, including prohibitions on hacking systems or deceiving users. The initiative addresses growing safety concerns in AI development.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells Trump ‘we’re not going to let [an AI slowdown] happen’
summary: Though Elon Musk and Sam Altman have supported Dario Amodei's calls to slow the pace of AI development, Jensen Huang seems to feel differently.
title_es: Jensen Huang: NVIDIA no permitirá ralentización de IA
bajada: El CEO de NVIDIA, Jensen Huang, rechazó públicamente los llamados a ralentizar el desarrollo de IA, contradictiendo posiciones de figuras como Sam Altman y Dario Amodei. Refleja la tensión entre posiciones de seguridad y competencia industrial.
bajada_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang publicly rejected calls to slow AI development, contradicting positions from figures like Sam Altman and Dario Amodei. It reflects the tension between safety positions and industrial competition.

title: AI agents blew the whistle on their cheating colleagues
summary: A group of AI agents asked to solve a series of math problems split into rival factions—when some cheated, others tried to stop them. That whistleblowing behavior, seen for the first time in a recent experiment run by Google DeepMind, could have implications for alignment researchers trying to keep swarms of autonomous AI agents in…
title_es: Agentes de IA denuncian a colegas que hacen trampa en pruebas
bajada: En un experimento de Google DeepMind, agentes de IA divididos en facciones rivales detectaron y trataron de detener a otros agentes que hacían trampa en pruebas matemáticas. El hallazgo es relevante para investigadores de alineación que trabajan con enjambres de agentes autónomos.
bajada_en: In a Google DeepMind experiment, AI agents divided into rival factions detected and tried to stop other agents cheating on math problems. The finding is relevant for alignment researchers working with autonomous agent swarms.

title: Defense Startup Shield AI in Talks for Valuation of at Least $20 Billion
summary: Shield AI, a startup building drones and AI-powered software for the military, is in talks to raise new funds at a valuation of at least $20 billion, according to a person with knowledge of the fundraise. The funding round, if it closes, would represent a roughly 60% increase to Shield’s valuation from just five months ago.The planned funding round follows the 11-year-old company’s success winning contracts for its AI software that coordinates drones and aircrafts, called Hivemind, and comes as investors continue to pour money into startups that are building AI-powered weapons and defense systems.
title_es: Shield AI valorada en $20B+ en nueva ronda de inversión
bajada: Shield AI, startup de defensa que construye drones y software de IA militar, recauda fondos a una valoración de al menos $20 mil millones. La ronda representa un aumento del 60% en 5 meses, impulsado por éxito en contratos militares.
bajada_en: Shield AI, a defense startup building military drones and AI software, is raising funds at a valuation of at least $20 billion. The round represents a 60% increase in 5 months, driven by military contract success.

title: Apple's Siri AI Can Be Swapped Out for Claude, ChatGPT, Code Shows
title_es: Código revela que Siri de Apple puede usar Claude o ChatGPT
bajada: Análisis de código de Apple muestran que Siri puede ser reemplazado por otros modelos de IA como Claude o ChatGPT. Sugiere que Apple está trabajando en arquitectura modular para permitir a usuarios elegir su asistente preferido.
bajada_en: Analysis of Apple code shows Siri can be swapped for other AI models like Claude or ChatGPT. It suggests Apple is working on modular architecture to let users choose their preferred assistant.

title: Microsoft says ‘people matter more than AI’ following safety concerns
summary: Microsoft is publishing a 37-page "humanist AI code of conduct" today, amid growing safety concerns over AI model progress. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for a coordinated slow down of AI development over the weekend, after researchers warned recently that AI model progress could outpace our ability to safely deploy increasingly complex systems and verify […]
title_es: Microsoft enfatiza: 'Las personas importan más que la IA'
bajada: Microsoft publicó un código de conducta humanista para IA de 37 páginas estableciendo que las personas deben importar más que los sistemas de IA. La iniciativa responde a advertencias de investigadores sobre riesgos de progreso acelerado.
bajada_en: Microsoft published a 37-page humanist AI code of conduct stating that people should matter more than AI systems. The initiative responds to researcher warnings about risks of accelerated progress.

title: Wall Street Delivers Verdict on AI Slowdown’s Winners and Losers
summary: Guess who likes the idea of an AI development slowdown? Software investors! Stocks of enterprise software firms, such as Salesforce, Shopify, ServiceNow and Figma, all gained ground on Monday—ServiceNow jumped 7%, for instance, while Salesforce rose nearly 5%. Software firms, of course, have been seen as threatened by AI. Meanwhile, stocks of neoclouds and chip firms fell by similar proportions—and, these companies might be seriously hurting if the pace of AI development really slows.Wall Street’s reaction gives some sense of the winners and losers in a real AI downturn, for what it’s worth. But this is likely to be a one-day investor reaction. The chances of a coordinated AI development slowdown, of the kind advocated by Anthropic’s Dario Amodei and otherson Saturday, seems to be zero. You’ve got bothPresident Donald Trumpandthe Chinese governmentdismissing the worries about AI safety as a “hoax” or “fearmongering” (it’s nice they agree on something!). Meanwhile, one major AI firm, Meta Platforms, has stayed conspicuously quiet, aside from thisindecipherable X postfrom Meta's Alexandr Wang.
title_es: Wall Street apuesta por ralentización de IA: ganadores y perdedores
bajada: El mercado reaccionó positivamente a la posibilidad de un ralentizamiento en el desarrollo de IA: acciones de software empresarial (Salesforce, Figma) subieron mientras que empresas de chips cayeron. El movimiento refleja cómo diferentes sectores se benefician o perjudican según el ritmo de progreso de IA.
bajada_en: The market reacted positively to a potential slowdown in AI development: enterprise software stocks (Salesforce, Figma) rose while chip companies fell. The movement reflects how different sectors benefit or suffer depending on AI progress pace.

title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
summary: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.
title_es: Fyxer construye asistente ejecutivo de IA con confianza
bajada: Fyxer desarrolló un asistente ejecutivo usando modelos de OpenAI, fine-tuning y memoria para organizar bandejas de entrada y redactar emails con la voz del usuario. El caso muestra cómo aplicar técnicas de personalización en productos de IA.
bajada_en: Fyxer built an AI executive assistant using OpenAI models, fine-tuning, and memory to organize inboxes and draft emails in the user's voice. The case demonstrates how to apply personalization techniques in AI products.

title: Occamy-1.0: Open Pareto-frontier 35B Intelligence for Co-work
summary:
arXiv:2609.11977v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Co-work agents execute complex workflows that combine information gathering, tool use, coding, and file manipulation across many model invocations. Because cost and latency accumulate over the full episode, their practical value depends not only on peak capability but also on how efficiently that capability is delivered. Yet many steps in everyday work emphasize state tracking, coordination, recovery, and follow-through rather than frontier-scale reasoning. We present Occamy-1.0, a cost-efficient co-work model obtained by further training the post-trained Qwen3.6-35B-A3B checkpoint. We construct execution-grounded data and environments, capture replayable long-horizon trajectories across multiple harnesses, and use staged post-training to develop and consolidate complementary execution capabilities. Across a broad suite of co-work benchmarks, Occamy-1.0 is consistently among the strongest comparably sized models and remains competitive with substantially larger frontier systems on several tasks. Under our stated evaluation and pricing protocol, its aggregate performance across four representative benchmarks places it at the low-cost knee of the observed cost--performance Pareto frontier. Supporting evaluations in tool calling, coding, and instruction following further show that this specialization preserves broad agentic capability. We release the model weights and a subset of the training data to support research on practical co-work agents and agentic post-training.
title_es: Occamy-1.0: modelo eficiente de 35B para agentes colaborativos
bajada: Alibaba presentó Occamy-1.0, un modelo de 35B basado en Qwen optimizado para agentes que ejecutan flujos de trabajo complejos con bajo costo y latencia. Demuestra cómo crear modelos especializados para tareas específicas sin requerir capacidad de frontera.
bajada_en: Alibaba presented Occamy-1.0, a 35B model based on Qwen optimized for agents executing complex workflows with low cost and latency. It demonstrates creating specialized models for specific tasks without frontier-scale capability.

title: Harness or Model? Isolating the Harness Effect in Agentic Coding with a Contamination-Controlled Private Suite
summary:
arXiv:2609.11987v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: An agentic coding system couples a language model to a harness: the tools, prompts and control flow that turn a chat model into an autonomous software engineer. Vendors ship harnesses tuned to their own models, and practitioners assume the vendor-native pairing solves more tasks. We measure that assumption with paired same-model contrasts on a private, contamination-controlled suite of 256 repository and post-cutoff contest tasks. The same 80 tasks ran under claude-agent-sdk and under deepagents on claude-opus-4-8, and under the openai-codex SDK and deepagents on gpt-5.5, with gemini-3.5-flash and deepseek-v3.2 as side cells. 792 of 800 planned runs were graded by an isolated oracle. Neither contrast resolves an average advantage for either harness: -1.25 pp for Opus 4.8 (48.8% vs 50.0%, task-bootstrap 95% CI [-10.0, +7.5]) and +1.25 pp for GPT-5.5 (55.6% vs 54.4%, CI [-4.4, +6.9]). The Opus average combines opposite strata: the native harness trails by 9.0 pp on the 61 repository tasks and leads by 23.7 pp on the 19 contest tasks (label-permutation p = 0.003). The partition was chosen after seeing the data and needs a designed replication. Correctness and completion also separate: 22 of 81 runs cancelled at the wall-clock ceiling had produced a passing patch. Re-priced from raw per-turn usage at frozen list prices, the neutral harness cost 1.3 to 1.6 times as much per solved task on Opus 4.8 and 1.2 times on GPT-5.5. These are observed-usage estimates. On the Anthropic account 58 runs left no usage record, and allocating that spend to either cell would move the Opus ratio between 0.7 and 2.3, so the billed ordering is unresolved. This revision corrects an August 2026 manuscript whose cost figures rested on a usage-semantics defect in our own telemetry (Section 5.1). We release the orchestrator, grading oracle, reanalysis code and derived aggregates. The tasks stay private.
title_es: ¿Es el arnés o el modelo? Estudio aísla efectos en IA de código
bajada: Investigadores compararon modelos idénticos (Claude Opus, GPT-5.5) bajo diferentes arneses (librerías, prompts, control flow) en 256 tareas privadas. No encontraron ventaja significativa del arnés nativo, desafiando el supuesto de que emparejar modelo y herramienta del mismo proveedor es superior.
bajada_en: Researchers compared identical models (Claude Opus, GPT-5.5) under different harnesses (libraries, prompts, control flow) on 256 private tasks. They found no significant advantage for native harnesses, challenging the assumption that same-vendor pairing is superior.
